name: Moire Bubbles (twisted bubble v1)
description: The twisted-bubble study set: a 2 deg twisted bilayer with a fixed-N gas pocket and a free peel front, preset for the two placements that differ only in where the gas sits - BETWEEN the layers, and BELOW the whole bilayer. Same physics as Moire Bubbles in Bilayers; this copy carries the exact settings used for the comparison figures.
